diagnosis.reasoning: Arrival rate actually fell 78% and token rate only rose 23%, so this is not a load-driven capacity event; instead the prefix cache hit rate collapsed from 0.97 to 0.11, so nearly every prompt token must now be computed (prefill_kv_computed_p99 up 22114x vs only ~8x longer prompts). That inflates prefill_time and KV usage (0.07->0.83), which in turn drives the massive waiting queue and queue_time that dominate TTFT. prefill_cost, kv_cache_pressure, queueing and the trace preemption are all downstream effects of the caching failure.
